Phase B5: dump-flower-fruit-phenology-audit.ts 업데이트. openFlowerCount DEPRECATED (SSOT #92) → flowerBud + openFlowerTransient 분리. abortedCount → 4-way split. cause categories: pre_anthesis_flower_drop / post_fert_starvation_abortion / pruning_to_target / unknown_aborted_warn.

Phase C1 Conservation ✓: 매 day 매 truss 7-state sum == fruits.length (정확히). unknown_aborted_count == 0 모든 day (legacy aborted path 없음 confirmed).
